calls.head: The Kraken can’t afford to cough it up
calls.body: The Kraken give up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most, and the Flames pounce.
calls.call: The Flames get at least their usual 7.5% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
calls.nums: Calgary 9th for chances off turnovers (7.5% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Seattle 25th for avoiding breakdowns
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 0 and 0 games this season
calls.happened: 15.5% of Calgary’s 5-on-5 chances came right after winning the puck, against their usual 7.5%.

calls.head: The Kraken’s defense joins the attack; the Flames’ stays home
calls.body: The Kraken are near the top of the league for shots from defensemen, at the active D end; the Flames are near the bottom of the league, at the forward-led end. Expect that gap to show.
calls.call: The Kraken’s defensemen take a bigger share of the team’s shot attempts than the Flames’.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 0 and 0 games this season
calls.happened: On share of 5-on-5 shot attempts taken by defensemen, Seattle had 27% and Calgary 35%. Coming in, Seattle was at 36% and Calgary at 32%.

CGY.head: We had this close to even (53% for Calgary), and it went Seattle’s way.

SEA.head: We had this close to even (47% for Seattle), and Seattle came through.

surprises.head: Calgary leaned on their bottom six
surprises.body: Calgary’s bottom-six forwards played 47% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against their usual 42% and a league average of 42%. A team strays this far about once every 35 games.

surprises.head: A rough night for D. Wolf
surprises.body: D. Wolf allowed 6 goals on shots worth 4.1 expected goals, 1.9 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 9 starts over the last three seasons.

story.head: The Kraken roll past the Flames
paras: The Kraken had this one put away early. Jordan Eberle opened the scoring midway through the first. Six different Kraken scored.
The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Kraken win about four in five.

items.text: One of the preview’s two calls held.
